Rows.Description: You, or a friend, threw a really swinging party. No one spreads joy like a Hero.

Rows.Title: The Party Animal
Rows.Description: Get five villagers drunk in under three minutes, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Menace To Society
Rows.Description: You, or a friend, committed an act of public indecency. Oh, the shame of it.

Rows.Title: The Black Knight
Rows.Description: Shoot the weapons from a hollow man's hands, blow off his head and then kill him for good!

Rows.Title: The Duellist
Rows.Description: String together a full-speed chain attack, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Sharpshooter
Rows.Description: Hit three enemies with one shot, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Archmage
Rows.Description: Five human enemies were killed with one magnificent spell.

Rows.Title: The Ruler of Albion
Rows.Description: Amass a 2.5 million gold real estate empire, or be there when another Hero does.

Rows.Title: The Hoarder
Rows.Description: Collect every silver key, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Goth
Rows.Description: Everybody knows black is the coolest colour.

Rows.Title: The Completionist
Rows.Description: Get all expressions, pet tricks and abilities, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Paragon
Rows.Description: You, or a friend, have taken morality to its utmost extreme. Neutral Heroes are so boring.

Rows.Title: The Extremist
Rows.Description: You, or a friend, have taken purity or corruption to its utmost extreme.

Rows.Title: The Celebrity
Rows.Description: Reach 50,000 renown, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Artisan
Rows.Description: Succeed at one job to Level 5, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Dollcatcher
Rows.Description: Collect all the Hero dolls, or see another Hero collect them.

Rows.Title: The Muse
Rows.Description: The whole of Albion has heard the songs you've commissioned about yourself. Show-off.

Rows.Title: The Companions
Rows.Description: Perform a perfect co-op expression.

Rows.Title: The Double Threat
Rows.Description: You achieved a co-op combat bonus.

Rows.Title: The Philanthropist
Rows.Description: A gift was sent to an Xbox LIVE friend. Aren't Heroes nice people?

Rows.Title: The Whippersnapper
Rows.Description: A child Hero collected five gold pieces for a fateful purpose.

Rows.Title: The New Hero
Rows.Description: Thag the Impatient has been defeated. Albion has a new Hero.

Rows.Title: The Hero of Strength
Rows.Description: You were there when the Hero of Strength was recruited.

Rows.Title: The Hero of Will
Rows.Description: You were there when the Hero of Will was recruited.

Rows.Title: The Hero of Skill
Rows.Description: You were there when the Hero of Skill was recruited.

Rows.Title: The Sacrifice
Rows.Description: A Hero must choose 'The Needs of the Many'.

Rows.Title: The Family
Rows.Description: The Needs of The Few' has condemned thousands to death so that loved ones might live.

Rows.Title: The Egomaniac
Rows.Description: A Hero must choose 'The Needs of the One'.

Rows.Title: The Collector
Rows.Description: Acquire all the mystery items in The Box of Secrets shop, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Meteorologist
Rows.Description: Bring all of Knothole Island’s weather problems under control, or help another Hero to do so.

Rows.Title: The Bibliophile
Rows.Description: Find all the books detailing the history of Knothole Island, or help another Hero to do so.

Rows.Title: The Nutcracker
Rows.Description: Score 25 groin shots, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Paramour
Rows.Description: Make love 25 times, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Concierge
Rows.Description: Open all the Demon Doors in Albion, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Visionary
Rows.Description: Take a look into the future, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Con Artist
Rows.Description: Find all 10 of Murgo's statuettes, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Howler
Rows.Description: Scare five people while dressed as a balverine, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Ghastly Jester
Rows.Description: Make five people laugh while dressed as a hobbe, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Repugnant
Rows.Description: Disgust five people while dressed as a hollow man, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Gladiator
Rows.Description: Score a total high score of 20,000 points or more in the Colosseum, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Multiplicator
Rows.Description: Achieve a multiplier of 10 or more in the Colosseum, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Combatant
Rows.Description: Defeat the necromancer in the Colosseum, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Fowl Player
Rows.Description: Dress as a chicken and kick five chickens during the Colosseum battles, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Colourist
Rows.Description: Collect the dyes hidden in Murgo's magical items, or see another Hero do so.

Rows.Title: The Guild Seal
Rows.Description: The Guild Seal reacted to your touch. You're a Hero! But then, you knew that already.

Rows.Title: And So It Begins
Rows.Description: You've taken your first steps towards gathering a rebel force to stand against your brother.

Rows.Title: Swift Justice
Rows.Description: Major Swift and his men have joined your cause. How can you fail with that moustache on your side?

Rows.Title: The Resistance
Rows.Description: The people of Bowerstone are behind you, ready to stand up against your brother.

Rows.Title: Distant Friends
Rows.Description: You convinced the Aurorans to to join your cause. It's time for a revolution!

Rows.Title: The Ruler of Albion
Rows.Description: You led a revolution and now the throne is yours. How will history judge your rule?

Rows.Title: For Albion!
Rows.Description: You killed the Crawler and ended the greatest threat ever to loom over Albion. You are a legend.

Rows.Title: Save The Princess!
Rows.Description: You rescued a piece of cardboard and gained valuable insight into the game development process.

Rows.Title: Ghost Brothers
Rows.Description: Not even death can put squabbling siblings to rest, but at least they're safely back with Mother.

Rows.Title: Tragical-Comical-Historical
Rows.Description: Your literary investigations have unearthed a one-of-a-kind play. Shame it stinks.

Rows.Title: The Dark Sanctum
Rows.Description: You have reinstated the Dark Sanctum. Come back to see it in all its glory and discover its secrets.

Rows.Title: Island Paradise
Rows.Description: Thanks to you, there is a new, thriving community away from the stresses of the modern world.

Rows.Title: Knight Jumps Chesty
Rows.Description: You beat an inanimate object at chess. Although to be fair, it is a very evil inanimate object.

Rows.Title: Coronation Chicken
Rows.Description: You brought a real sense of gravitas to your role of monarch. That and feathers.

Rows.Title: Spellweaver
Rows.Description: You may well be the first Hero in history to weave two spells together. And wasn't it pretty?

Rows.Title: Archmage
Rows.Description: Magic holds no secrets for you. If it did, you'd probably cast a "make magic talk" spell on it.

Rows.Title: Total Warrior
Rows.Description: Killed enemies with Melee, Ranged and Spell Attacks. Which is your favourite then?

Rows.Title: Pull!
Rows.Description: You dispatched an enemy while he was airborne. At least he went with style.

Rows.Title: Gunning For Glory
Rows.Description: Few have ever put the trigger to such bloody use.

Rows.Title: If It Bleeds, We Can Kill It
Rows.Description: You're a one-Hero army. A pure massacring machine. A total killing-- well, you get the idea.

Rows.Title: Wizard's Revenge
Rows.Description: They called you a nerd. They called you spotty. They mocked your beard. So you killed them all.

Rows.Title: Super Hero
Rows.Description: You are the ultimate Hero. A master in every discipline. In other words, you're awesome.

Rows.Title: You Can't Bring Me Down
Rows.Description: Complete Fable III without being knocked out in combat.

Rows.Title: My Weapon's Better Than Yours
Rows.Description: You have fully upgraded an already historical weapon. It doesn't get any more legendary than that.

Rows.Title: I Am The Keymaster
Rows.Description: Collect all 50 Silver Keys and 4 Gold Keys.

Rows.Title: Flower Power
Rows.Description: Collect all 30 Auroran flowers.

Rows.Title: Gnome Invasion
Rows.Description: Destroy all 50 gnomes.

Rows.Title: Brightwall Book Club
Rows.Description: Collect all 30 rare books for the Brightwall Academy.

Rows.Title: Digger
Rows.Description: Hunting for treasure isn't always glamourous. The dirt under your fingernails can attest to that.

Rows.Title: We Need Guns, Lots Of Guns
Rows.Description: Collect all 50 legendary weapons. They won’t all appear in your world, so trade with other Heroes!

Rows.Title: Fashion Victim
Rows.Description: Collect every item of clothing.

Rows.Title: He's a Woman. She's a Man
Rows.Description: Heroes have long been free from the boundaries of normal society. What is normal anyway?

Rows.Title: Dye Hippie, Dye
Rows.Description: You look, like, totally amazing, man. Can you feel the universe touching you yet?

Rows.Title: Hand in Hand
Rows.Description: You've held hands with another person. What better way to make a connection?

Rows.Title: Long Distance Relationship
Rows.Description: You married another player! N.B. Marriage not binding in any real court of law.

Rows.Title: Cross-Dimensional Conception
Rows.Description: Have a child with another Xbox LIVE player.

Rows.Title: Online Merger
Rows.Description: You are the epitome of a modern day Hero, unafraid to embrace newfangled technologies.

Rows.Title: Barrel of Laughs
Rows.Description: You annihilated 30 enemies using explosive barrels. Isn't it nice how conveniently placed they are?

Rows.Title: We Can Be Heroes
Rows.Description: Earn 1,000 gold in henchman wages in another Hero's world.

Rows.Title: Kaboom!
Rows.Description: You scored 2000 on the Mourningwood Fort mortar game. Private Jammy is proud of you.

Rows.Title: Lute Hero Tour
Rows.Description: Play in each town as a 5 star lute player.

Rows.Title: Touched By A Hero
Rows.Description: At least twenty people in Albion have felt the hand of Hero touch them. In a good way, we hope.

Rows.Title: Popularity Contest
Rows.Description: Make 20 Friends.

Rows.Title: Remodelling
Rows.Description: Who said interior decorating was incompatible with leading a revolution? No one.

Rows.Title: Magnate Personality
Rows.Description: You've amassed a fortune in real estate. Just as well there's no window tax.

Rows.Title: Crime Spree
Rows.Description: Get a 15,000 gold bounty placed on your head.

Rows.Title: Henry VIII
Rows.Description: As ruler of Albion, get married 6 times and kill 2 of your spouses.

Rows.Title: Chest Grandmaster
Rows.Description: You have uncovered every last piece of Hero lore. The Road to Rule is a road well travelled.

Rows.Title: Tough Love
Rows.Description: You had to make a lot of difficult and unpopular decisions, but they were the right ones.

Rows.Title: Adopt Or Die
Rows.Description: Good for you. Why bring more people into the world when there are poor, parentless children around?

Rows.Title: A Slow Day At The Office
Rows.Description: There's nothing like an attempt on your life to liven up a boring day.

Rows.Title: Science And Industry
Rows.Description: You've found the first escaped prisoner. Is Albion safer now?

Rows.Title: Unnatural Laws
Rows.Description: You've found the second prisoner. Have you ever wondered what your nature is?

Rows.Title: Who Are You?
Rows.Description: There is no third prisoner. Or perhaps it's you, sitting on that throne forever more.

Rows.Title: Keeping It Real
Rows.Description: Decide the future of the Keep.

Rows.Title: I, Robot. You, Idiot
Rows.Description: You helped Huxley construct a friend. You'd think he'd be more grateful.

Rows.Title: Diary Of A Sad Man
Rows.Description: You collected all of Faraday's diary pages, and learned some history in the process.

Rows.Title: Lab Notes
Rows.Description: Find all of Witchcraft Mary's diaries.

Rows.Title: A Revolutionary Idea
Rows.Description: Find all of General Turner's diaries.

Rows.Title: Set Them Free!
Rows.Description: What does freedom mean to a talking piece of stone? Free speech, one supposes.

Rows.Description: Unlock 50 cosmetic items from the store

Rows.Title: Shopping Spree
Rows.Description: Unlock 10 cosmetic items from the store

Rows.Description: Equip your first cosmetic item

Rows.Description: Equip your first legendary customization item
